Cowboy Up is on a three-game losing streak and needs Joe Burrow at 24.2 to carry a lot of weight, and I'm not sure that's enough.

Maverick (0-9) is staring at a nine-game losing streak against Da Dangsters (6-3), who project to 116.7 with Trey McBride and Chuba Hubbard leading the charge. Bring The Pain (2-7), riding a four-game losing streak, takes on the Computer Jocks, and I'm told that one is a must-win for both sides.
